label: Execution Drain
description: The primary execution of a unit of work as a plan drain: delegate to the generic phased-plan-drain (executed_by) to drain the bound plan slice-by-slice, then stop when the plan completes or blocks. Reuses the drain mechanics rather than duplicating them. Implements the execution-run and execution-retry operations.
best_for: Draining an item's bound plan as its primary execution
Retrying a failed execution as a fresh drain
not_for: Exploratory work without a stable plan — use holistic-loop
tradeoffs: Reuses phased-plan-drain via one-level delegation — execution mechanics live once
complete opens review; blocked parks for operator attention
